items.title: Trim the WEB_CAREER_DISCOVERY lane once automatic intake is reliable?
items.detail: The source-trial Action already reads ~160 employer job boards every run. Grok's WEB_CAREER_DISCOVERY lane searches many of the same career sites. Once automatic intake (armed 2026-10-23) has run cleanly for a few days, the lane could be cut down to the priority companies the Action finds no board for (Tesla, Anduril, LeoLabs and others in the source-trial report).

items.title: Pay for a proxy so JobSpy can read ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor?
items.detail: On GitHub's servers ZipRecruiter and Glassdoor block every JobSpy search (403) and Google returns nothing; LinkedIn is partly rate-limited (429). Fixing it needs a paid residential proxy. Until then the ChatGPT ZIPRECRUITER_WEEKLY lane is the only ZipRecruiter coverage and must stay.
options: Buy a proxy and then retire the lane
items.recommended: Keep the lane; a proxy costs money every month for one source.
